title: pvOpenFOAMReader
body:
## pvOpenFOAMReader

Full native OpenFOAM reader: opens a case through its .foam marker and outputs a multiblock dataset with the selected mesh regions (internalMesh, patches, patch groups, Lagrangian clouds and optionally zones) carrying cell, point and Lagrangian fields for each stored time. Omitted settings keep ParaView's own defaults: Reconstructed Case, the 0 directory skipped, point data interpolated from cell fields, 32-bit labels and 64-bit scalars. Use the curated foam operation for the common case (decomposed case, internalMesh only, 0 kept); use this one for point or Lagrangian fields, zones, binary label/scalar sizes and the other native options.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- SkipZeroTime is true by ParaView default, so the initial conditions in 0/ are not offered as a time; set it false to inspect them.
- For binary cases, LabelSize and ScalarSize must match how OpenFOAM was built (e.g. 64-bit labels); a mismatch misreads the files.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `OpenFOAMReader`. Identity: `sources/OpenFOAMReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Adddimensionalunitstoarraynames` | Read dimensional units from field data and add them to array names as human-readable string. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Cachemesh` | Cache the OpenFOAM mesh between GUI selection changes. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `CaseType` | The property indicates whether decomposed mesh or reconstructed mesh should be read | `{"type":"enum","values":["Decomposed Case","Reconstructed Case"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"Decomposed Case"` |
| `CellArrays` | Cell-centred fields to read from the time directories (OpenFOAM volume fields such as p, U, T, k or nut). Fields not listed are not loaded; an empty list loads the mesh without cell fields. With Createcelltopointfiltereddata on (ParaView default) each selected field is also interpolated to points. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Copydatatocellzones` | Copy data of internal mesh to the cell zones | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Createcelltopointfiltereddata` | Create point data from cell data. Beware: the filter does not do inverse distance weighting. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `LabelSize` | The expected label-size for the OpenFOAM data. | `{"type":"enum","values":["32-bit","64-bit"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"32-bit"` |
| `LagrangianArrays` | Fields of Lagrangian particle clouds (files under <time>/lagrangian/<cloud>/, such as d for diameter or U for particle velocity) to attach to the particle points. They appear only for clouds whose lagrangian/<cloud> region is selected in MeshRegions. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Lagrangianpositionswithoutextradata` | Lagrangian positions without extra data (before OpenFOAM 1.4, after 2.4) | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ListtimestepsaccordingtocontrolDict` | List time directories listed according to the settings in controlDict. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `MeshRegions` | Mesh parts to load, each becoming a block: internalMesh (volume cells), patch/<name> boundaries, group/<name> patch groups and lagrangian/<cloud> particle clouds; with Readzones on, zones are offered too. Multi-region cases prefix names with /<region>/. Loading fewer regions reduces memory and read time. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PointArrays` | Point fields stored by the case itself (OpenFOAM point fields, e.g. pointDisplacement in moving-mesh cases). These are not the interpolated point data created from cell fields by Createcelltopointfiltereddata, which needs no selection here. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `Readzones` | Read point/face/cell-Zones? | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ScalarSize` | The expected scalar-size for the OpenFOAM data. | `{"type":"enum","values":["32-bit (SP)","64-bit (DP)"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"32-bit (SP)"` |
| `SkipZeroTime` | Ignore the 0/ time directory. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `WeightPointDataByCellSize` | Use cell size as weight in cell data-to-point data procedure. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

onVisit commands:

```json
{
  "Refresh": {
    "command": "SetRefresh",
    "native": "Refresh"
  }
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvOpenFOAMReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
Example command request (pipeline node only): `"onVisit":["Refresh"]`. Commands run in this authored order before the update.
